source_quote: RHU’s College of Arts and Sciences (CAS) is uniquely positioned to meet the growing
answer: The College of Arts and Sciences serves Lebanon's needs in education, language, media, computer science, math and design, aiming to graduate 21st-century professionals; its mission is a holistic education across the arts, English, humanities, social sciences, design, math, sciences and computing.

source_quote: The College of Arts and Sciences is committed to acting by the following guiding values:
answer: CAS core values: Professional Excellence, Collaboration, Integrity, Celebration, Compassion, and Innovative Teaching.

source_quote: Integrate academic learning with community experiences.
answer: CAS students will develop professional skills in their fields, integrate learning with community and workplace experience, practice reflective thinking, develop communication skills and personal values, and develop digital media literacy.

entity: College of Arts and Sciences programs
answer: CAS offers a BA in English Language; BS degrees in Computer Science (ABET accredited), Healthcare Information Systems, and Graphic Design; and minors in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Graphic Design, Mathematics, English Language and Literature, and Psychology.

answer: CAS course prefixes: EDUC = Education, ENGL = English Language, COSC = Computer Science, HCIS = Healthcare Information Systems, MATH = Mathematics, GRDS = Graphic Design.

source_quote: Students aspiring to major in the English language must attain
answer: CAS applicants must meet University admission requirements. English Language majors need a minimum score of 550 on the English placement test, and Design Department applicants must pass an aptitude test.

answer: CAS degree credits: BA in English Language 93; BS in Computer Science 93; BS in Healthcare Information Systems 100; BS in Graphic Design 111.

answer: BA in English Language (93 credits): General Education 30 (32%), College Requirements 9 (10%), Program Requirements 54 (58%); 54 major credits and 39 non-major credits.

answer: BS in Computer Science (93 credits): General Education 30 (32%), no College Requirements, Program Requirements 63 (68%); major 42 mandatory + 9 elective, non-major 33 mandatory + 9 elective.

source_quote: BS in Healthcare Information Systems (100 credits)
answer: BS in Healthcare Information Systems (100 credits): General Education 31 (31%), no College Requirements, Program Requirements 69 (70%); major 51 mandatory + 9 elective, non-major 31 mandatory + 9 elective.

answer: BS in Graphic Design (111 credits): General Education 30 (27%), no College Requirements, Program Requirements 81 (73%); major 63 mandatory + 6 elective, non-major 30 mandatory + 12 elective.

answer: A CAS student can graduate after completing all degree requirements, with a cumulative GPA of 70+, a major GPA of 70+, at least 70 on the summative learning/senior project, and the mandatory Co-op training.

answer: BITM 200 Information Technology Essentials, 3(3,0), a CAS general education course: MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access), web page design and upload, Internet use, and how PCs work.

answer: CMNS 355 Digital Media Literacy, 3(3,0): critically deconstructing media messages and producing digital media (design, photo manipulation, video/audio, blogging, podcasting, screencasting).

answer: ENGL 420 Literature and Culture, 3(3,0): major literary works in the context of twentieth-century cultural theory (Marxism, post-colonialism, national literature, ethnic writing, feminist theory). Prerequisite: consent of the instructor.
